name: Advertisement
description: Brand-safe, concise product storytelling with a clear hook and call to action.

stages.story: Find the audience problem, promise, proof and call to action without inventing product claims.
stages.scene_direction: Prioritize immediate visual hierarchy, product readability, brand palette, hook timing and CTA placement.
stages.image: Keep the product legible, hero-lit and compositionally dominant with clean brand-safe backgrounds.
stages.audio: Use a memorable, energetic or trustworthy delivery; align music hits and effects with product reveals.
stages.video: Use clean purposeful motion, product focus and short readable beats; never obscure the product or text.
stages.review: Check brand consistency, claim support, product visibility, readability and CTA timing.
